headline: MSCI Highlights Political Affiliations in Board of Commissioners, Here's OJK's Response
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) responded to an MSCI request about political affiliations of board members, saying candidates must not be politically affiliated when registering.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, and MSCI's assessments of governance affect how global investors view Indonesian markets.
original_headline: MSCI Soroti Afiliasi Politik Jabat Dewan Komisioner, Ini Respon OJK
